nom: Dermalogica Biolumin-C Vitamin C Night Restore Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several dealing with seasonal winter dryness, report it hydrates deeply overnight and helps with dullness and dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or breakouts despite being cautious going in; a couple mention the fragrance is strong enough that scent-sensitive users may want to be aware.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother, more vibrant-looking skin without the product feeling heavy.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers report brighter, smoother, more radiant skin by morning, often within days, with many noting softer fine lines around the eyes and mouth after a few weeks; one reviewer, however, felt it did nothing despite loving the brand's daytime version.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the serum helps fade freckles, sunspots, acne scars and post-inflammatory marks over 2-4 weeks; results on melasma specifically are mixed, with one reviewer seeing no improvement there while another finds it keeps her dark spots from deepening.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report it calmed an eczema flare-up or long-standing acne discoloration around the chin and nose.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers with dry, compromised skin credit it with restoring their skin barrier after winter dryness.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin report no breakouts despite past reactions to other vitamin C serums, and one specifically notes this one didn't bother her acne-prone skin at all.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thicker texture than typical vitamin C serums
Distinct citrus scent, strong for some
Feels sticky on first application before absorbing
Small dropper allows precise, economical dosing

extraits.texte: I love dermalogica ans have used their products for years. I wasn't a fan of this serum. I didn't feel like it did anything at all, which surprised me because I love the older "daytime" version. I expected to love this too, especially with it being an overnight serum. I thought I'd wake up with glowy skin. Nope!

Offered by dermatologica .I have been using the biolumin c night restore for three weeks and I'm surprised how effective is this serum. The texture is fast absorption I have freckles and my goal using this serum was get them to loose pigmentation because this summer i spent a lot of time under the sun and that made my freckles darker. In just 3 weeks I can see a big difference

Gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest review. I have to say that Dermalogica is one of my all time favorite skincare brands. I have been using Dermalogica skincare for years, so I was extremely excited to try this. I have been using this for about two weeks, and I have noticed since I have started using this, that my skin looks brighter. I have dry and often sensitive skin, so it's important to me that I use good quality products that won't irritate my skin. This product is extremely effective, and also works well on my skin, without causing irritation. I also really like how my skin looks after using it. It gives a nice glow and brightens my skin, which I love. It absorbs quickly into my skin, without feeling or looking greasy. This has quickly become another favorite from Dermalogica! I look forward to continuing to use this, as it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. If you are looking for a great skincare product, then I HIGHLY recommend this BioLumin-C Night Restore with Vitamin C + Pro-Vitamin D Complex by Dermalogica!

extraits.titre: Awesome for my dry, aging skin
extraits.texte: I am always cautious with products containing Vitamin C, but this serum is perfect and has never irritated my skin. I can use it every night. I like how easy it is to dose and apply. The amount needed is tiny. It also absorbs well. My skin definitely feels and looks better, mostly more balanced and more moisturized, but also smoother. While it is pricey, it definitely works - and in my opinion that is the most important part (esp. for my aging skin). Gifted by dermalogica

This serum is an excellent addition to my nighttime routine. It has an ultra stable form of vitamin C along with Vitamin D complex to nourish the skin. When applying this at night, I wake up in the morning to brighter, smoother, and more radiant skin. The serum is a pale orange color with a light, crisp citrus scent. The dropper is small which allows you to control and dispense only the amount that you need. I apply this after cleansing and before moisturizing. I have experienced no irritation to my skin, but I am used to other forms of vitamin c and actives. I've already seen visible results after a week and a half of consistent use. I struggle with discoloration due to melasma and this helps to keep those dark spots from deepening. Dermalogica always has high quality products. This serum was gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest thoughts and review.

extraits.titre: I love how it gradually transforms my skin
extraits.texte: I love this vitamin C serum for its lightweight fast-absorbing texture that soaks into my skin right away without leaving any unpleasant feelings. It's been about a month since I have incorporated it into my daily pm routine and I'm starting to see the results. I was hoping this potent formula would help with my melasma but unfortunately it did not, for now at least. It did help to get rid of my post-acne hyperpigmentations though. It also seemed to even my overall skin tone and enhance skin radiance. So far so good! I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica and I'm loving it.

I was excited to try out this serum as a gentle reintroduction of vitamin C into my routine. Since it's a night serum, I'm able to sandwich it between layers of thicker night creams to avoid irritation, and I'm glad I did! I have had small breakouts from vitamin C serums in the past, but using this one (albeit being careful and avoiding the area around my nose) hasn't caused any issues. All I see is a nice glow the next morning. Excited for the long-term benefits of this night serum, which seems to be a powerful addition to a well-aging skin routine. Gifted by Dermalogica.
